package app

import (
	"net/http"

	"github.com/larsartmann/httputil"
)

// wire mounts the app with the v4-era CSRF re-exports (pre-upgrade shape).
func wire(mux *http.ServeMux) http.Handler {
	var csrfCfg httputil.CSRFConfig
	mux.Handle("POST /items", httputil.CSRFMiddleware(csrfCfg)(nil))

	token := httputil.CSRFToken
	_ = token

	return mux
}
